companyDescription: Lunar infrastructure & services · NASA Artemis program backbone + $1.1B backlog · Unique lunar surface access, data relay, and national security space ops
priceNote: Down 55-60% from $46.75 ATH — SpaceX IPO + profit-taking selloff. B. Riley says 'use the pullback as buying opportunity'.
summary: Intuitive Machines is the operating backbone of NASA's Artemis lunar program with a $1.1B backlog and record Q1 2026 revenue of $186.7M (beat consensus). The stock has been crushed 55% from ATH by SpaceX IPO capital rotation, creating a rare 118% upside opportunity. B. Riley reaffirmed Buy calling the selloff a buying opportunity. Q2 earnings Aug 6 and new lunar reconnaissance contracts are near-term catalysts.

catalysts.name: NASA Artemis Contract Pipeline
catalysts.description: Two new prime lunar reconnaissance contracts (LROC + ShadowCam) announced May 2026. $1.1B total backlog provides 3+ years revenue visibility. NASA CLPS contracts ongoing through 2030+.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Earnings Aug 6, 2026. Q1 2026 was record quarter: $186.7M revenue (beat $200M est. on EBITDA, beat on revenue), first-ever positive Adjusted EBITDA $2.7M. Market expects continued improvement.

catalysts.name: Goonhilly + COMSAT Acquisition Close
catalysts.description: LUNR acquiring Goonhilly Earth Station and COMSAT (announced May 2026) — expands space-to-Earth network capacity. Closes in H2 2026. Strategic: national security + commercial data relay.

risks: Stock offering risk: LUNR filed to sell Class A common stock Jun 2026 — dilution overhang could cap near-term upside
SpaceX IPO (SPCX) continues to siphon institutional capital from LUNR — direct sector competition
Still unprofitable on net basis: Net income -$109.9M TTM despite record EBITDA; needs scale
Single-customer concentration: Heavy NASA dependence — any NASA budget cuts would materially affect revenue
Revenue declined in 2025 (-7.87% YoY) before recovering in 2026 — visibility risk

macroRisk.rateOutlook: FOMC July 29. Space infrastructure with multi-year government contracts is partially insulated from rate sensitivity. Beta 1.68 = volatile but less than pure-speculative names.
macroRisk.inflationNote: NASA cost-plus contracts provide inflation protection. Gross margin expansion (record Q1 gross margin) suggests pricing power and operational leverage.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: LOW-MEDIUM macro sensitivity. Government contract revenue is sticky. The bigger risk is sector sentiment rotation out of space stocks, which is SpaceX IPO-driven not macro-driven.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk MEDIUM-LOW for LUNR specifically. Government contract backbone insulates revenue. The bigger risk is continued SpaceX IPO capital rotation and dilution from the stock offering. Wait for early August after FOMC to accumulate.

catalystSpot.preRunup: LUNR ran +80% in the 4 weeks before SpaceX IPO on 'rising tide lifts all space boats' momentum. New contract awards from NASA historically trigger 10-20% moves. Q1 2026 beat beat expectations and LUNR ran +13.9% that session.

postWin.note: LUNR Q1 2026 beat (May 14, 2026) — record revenue + positive EBITDA beat → stock +13.9% same session. Roth Capital raised PT from $50 to $75 → stock +13.9% more. Shows NASA milestone beats drive 15-25% moves.

postLose.note: LUNR IM-1 lander tipped over on lunar surface (Feb 2024) — partial mission success. Stock sold off -20% then recovered. IM-2 mission risk remains. Any mission failure would trigger -15-25% sector selloff.

spotSizing.reason: 118% upside from consensus PT justifies meaningful position. But stock offering dilution risk and SpaceX rotation keeps size at 5%. Scale to 8-10% after stock offering resolves and earnings confirm trajectory.

comparableCases.note: First US lunar landing since Apollo (partial success despite tipping) — stock tripled from $7 to $25 over 2 weeks. Shows that mission milestones are enormous re-rating events for LUNR.
Space infrastructure companies re-rate 30-50% on first commercial milestones. LUNR has recurring NASA contracts — more durable than SPCE but similar milestone-driven pattern.
Record Q1 revenue $186.7M + first positive Adjusted EBITDA → stock +13.9% same session. Q2 earnings Aug 6 is next potential 10-20% single-day move if trend continues.
